text.en: Each successive shot has more damage and more spread.

Each successive shot fired within 0.5 seconds of each other deals increasingly higher damage and has a wider pellet spread.

Broadside increases the damage of the 2|3|4|5th shot by 18%|39%|59%|81% damage in exchange for 25% increased pellet spread on the first shot and then 33% increased spread for all shots afterwards.
